type RawShellDiagnostics = {
	bufferStats(): { usedBytes: bigint };
	currentSeq(): bigint;
};

class RawShellDiagnosticsImplementation {
	bufferStats(): { usedBytes: bigint } {
		return { usedBytes: 0n };
	}

	currentSeq(): bigint {
		return 0n;
	}
}

export function escapeRawDiagnostics(shell: RawShellDiagnostics) {
	return {
		stats: shell.bufferStats(),
		sequence: shell.currentSeq(),
	};
}
